jsonld_raw.name: FASHIONABLY LONDON HAND CREAM 50ML
jsonld_raw.description: A scented hand cream featuring the Fashionably London fragrance. Ideal for pairing with the Eau de Parfum for a more tactile olfactory experience. Inspired by the relaxed sophistication of London, this fragrance blends the luminous freshness of bergamot with the modern femininity of rose and the enveloping softness of musk. A collection created by Ms. Jo Malone CBE, founder of Jo Loves. Musky floral | Elegant, luminous, and contemporary.
